verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions first-party integrations for LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the Vercel AI SDK. The official TypeScript/Python clients and the generic "wire it into a chat harness" quickstart are developer building blocks, not documented framework integrations. The setup CLI's "integration flow" is not tied to any named agent framework, so none of this earns credit for the story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop the memory layer into agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the Vercel AI SDK via documented first-party integrations
